objective: maximize cumulative user profit while enforcing verified-publication floors, minimizing intervention, and amplifying only evidence-backed winners

winnerAmplification.evidence: Current metrics record no BOOTH sales, no note sales/PV/likes, no Microsoft Store funnel metrics and no GitHub Pages conversion metrics.
winnerAmplification.decision: Do not spend production capacity on speculative derivative families merely because source products are public. Keep low-build-cost coherent bundle hypotheses in backlog, but activate only when observed demand appears.
winnerAmplification.activationRule: A theme becomes amplification-eligible after a clear relative quantitative signal (sale, conversion, acquisition, install/use outperformance) or multiple independent qualitative demand signals. Publication alone is insufficient.

firstCandidates.why: lowest incremental build cost and coherent complementary jobs; activate after any credible event/sponsor demand signal
coherent journey, but source verification and demand evidence must exist first
distinct adjacent job with low cannibalization if pre/post contract scope stays separate
distinct adjacent jobs; wait for thesis-theme signal

hardPublicationPolicy.rule: Publication debt remains a separate operational constraint. Winner-amplification logic must not erase debt or invent performance evidence.

measurementPriority.MicrosoftStore: Complete CSV Cleaner identity/submission first, then collect Store page views, install attempts, acquisitions, successful installs, first launches and source/campaign conversion before derivatives.
measurementPriority.note: Capture account-level article PV, likes and paid sales when available; compare themes on matched exposure windows.
measurementPriority.BOOTH: Capture orders/sales and, if available, product-page traffic/favorites; do not infer demand from buyer-visible status.
measurementPriority.GitHubPages: Capture tool traffic and outbound conversion/source evidence before treating a Web tool as a winner.

productionPriority: Recover paid publication debt with qualified distinct products during PC windows.
Complete Microsoft Store CSV Cleaner submission prerequisites and measurement plumbing.
Preserve conditional low-cost bundle candidates without calling them winners.
When observed performance arrives, move the strongest differentiated derivative to the front of product_backlog immediately.
antiSpamRules: No cosmetic app clones or name-only variants.
Every derivative must solve a meaningfully different job, audience, format or advanced workflow.
Do not cannibalize a winning single product with a cheaper bundle; bundles must add value and maintain sensible price architecture.
Do not infer sales, PV, conversion, acquisitions, installs or retention.
